title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 53-56 (Punyagandha, Suprasanna, Prasadabhimukhi, Prabha)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 53 to 56: Punyagandha, Suprasanna, Prasadabhimukhi, Prabha, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 53 to 56 with meaning
caption: Names 53 to 56 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 53 to 56**: **Punyagandha, Suprasanna, Prasadabhimukhi, Prabha**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Punyagandha, Suprasanna, Prasadabhimukhi, Prabha.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Punyagandha** means **Of sacred fragrance**. A sacred fragrance: purity felt around the Goddess.
**Suprasanna** means **Very gracious**. Always smiling and serene, ready to bless.
**Prasadabhimukhi** means **Turned towards grace**. Turned towards the devotee, eager to grant grace.
**Prabha** means **Radiance**. The light around her, and the splendour she gives to a devotee's life.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
